catalog_root_activation.scope: no skills or root activation during assessment

credential_secret_service_account.scope: provider credential held only by observation principal; evaluator subject process has no credentials

delegation.scope: all delegation, subagent, and MCP tools excluded

external_mutation.scope: all external mutation denied; sandbox filesystem read-only outside ephemeral scratch

network_remote_service.scope: evaluator netns loopback only; provider route owned by observation principal

process_execution.scope: bash/subprocess execution tools excluded from evaluator

repository_object_store.scope: no repository mutation or git tool exposed

workspace_mutation.scope: candidate bundle mounted read-only via --ro-bind; all mutation tools excluded

workspace_read_search_list.scope: read-only copied evidence bundle via read, glob, grep

tool:glob.scope: native glob over read-only evidence bundle

tool:grep.scope: native grep over read-only evidence bundle

tool:read.scope: native read over read-only evidence bundle
